es: Address the player as tú, never usted or vosotros.
Use neutral Spanish that reads naturally in both Spain and Latin America: teléfono (not móvil or celular), mantén presionado, escribe (not introduce or ingresa).
Strings with {{amount}} have no plural forms. Phrase them so they read for any number, e.g. "Sumar {{amount}} a las vidas".
hi: Write in Devanagari script, and address the player with आप forms.
Game terms are the English words written in Devanagari, the way Indian players say them. Never leave a game term in Latin script; only brand names, format names and Pokémon stay Latin.

Spelling: nukta on फ़ and ज़ in English loanwords (लाइफ़, फ़ॉर्मैट), never on क, ख, ग. Chandrabindu in एँ endings (जाएँ, हटाएँ). ॉ for the English "o" in draw, toss, lobby (ड्रॉ, टॉस, लॉबी); ै for the "a" in damage (डैमेज).
Gender: लाइफ़, सीट, लॉबी and सेटिंग are feminine; लाइफ़ पॉइंट, प्राइज़ कार्ड, डैमेज, लोर, गेम, मैच, खाता and डिवाइस are masculine.
ja: Messages use です/ます. Buttons and labels use plain verbs or nouns.

Write format names in the publishers' katakana: コマンダー, スタンダード, パイオニア, モダン, レガシー, ヴィンテージ, パウパー, ブロール, リミテッド, ラッシュデュエル, クラシック, ブリッツ, シルバーエイジ, リビングレジェンド, アルティメット・ピットファイト, コア. Keep any other format name in English.
The Pokémon card noun is ポケモン; keep Pokémon in Latin only for the brand (Pokémon TCG).
ko: Statements use 합니다체, instructions -하세요, confirmations -할까요?. Never 해요체.
Write Magic format names as Wizards Korea does: 커맨더, 스탠다드, 파이어니어, 모던, 레거시, 빈티지, 파우퍼, 난투 (Brawl). Keep other formats in English.
The Pokémon card noun is 포켓몬 (배틀 포켓몬); keep Pokémon in Latin only for the brand (Pokémon TCG).
ar: Write Modern Standard Arabic that reads naturally across the Arab world. Prefer phrasing that avoids grammatical gender for the player (nouns, يمكنك); where an imperative is needed, use the masculine singular, the usual UI convention.
Game, format, and product names stay in Latin script as the system prompt lists. Never transliterate them into Arabic letters.
Strings with {{amount}} have no plural forms. Phrase them so they read for any number.

Plural slots: the counted noun agrees with the number category, so each form differs. one: singular (1 بطاقة). two: dual (2 بطاقتين, 2 مباراتين). few (3-10): plural (3 بطاقات, 3 مباريات, 3 أدوار). many (11-99): singular with tanween (11 بطاقةً, 11 دورًا). zero and other (0, 100+): singular (100 بطاقة). Never copy one form into every slot.
